steps.subject: sky

steps.load: load plenty of paint in the bristles

steps.subject: leaf tree
steps.load: load deep into the brush, gray at the tips
steps.motion: press hard so some white shows through
steps.rule: This makes it stand out more clearly.

steps.subject: trunk/limbs

steps.load: a lot of the gray color

steps.load: very little paint, titanium white mixed with the magic black
steps.motion: follow the terrain contour with the knife
steps.rule: This should not be too bright.

steps.subject: mist
steps.action: lift clean brush upward for mist
steps.load: a clean 1in brush
steps.rule: This should recede into the background here.

steps.subject: trunk/limbs
steps.where: on these little trees back here
steps.rule: This adds visual interest to the painting.

steps.subject: snow

steps.load: very little paint on your knife
steps.where: maybe a layer of snow at this angle
steps.rule: This creates a change of value in this area.

steps.subject: leaf tree
steps.load: a tiny bit of white
steps.rule: This makes that side stand out more.

steps.subject: trunk/limbs
steps.motion: paint thinner to thin the paint
steps.rule: A limb may be placed at this location.

steps.subject: structure

steps.subject: structure

steps.subject: structure
